name: Package Evidence-Linked Relationship Proposals
jtbd: When an authorized graph snapshot has already yielded candidate links, validate node/evidence references and package them for human review before any graph write.
runtime: Python >=3.11; local CLI and stdio MCP
requires: Candidate relations with evidence IDs and rationale
limitations: Packages caller-proposed links; it does not discover/rank them or write graph edges.
This stage never writes to a MindrianOS room, graph, or canonical portfolio.
